selection: 12 vnc_sensory cells per rank tier for the 7 mechanosensory channels (ball_x, ball_y, ball_vx, ball_vy, flipper_left, flipper_right, tilted), ranked by direct synaptic weight onto vnc_motor; 12 LC4 cells per rank tier for the 4 velocity channels (vel1_L, vel1_C, vel1_R, vel2) and 12 LPLC2 cells per rank tier for the 4 size channels (size1_L, size1_C, size1_R, size2), ranked by direct synaptic weight onto descending_neuron (no direct LC/LPLC->vnc_motor synapses exist in this data - see Ache et al. 2019, Curr. Biol. for the linear-velocity + Gaussian-size Giant Fiber looming model this split is based on); top 64 vnc_motor cells by direct weight from the chosen mechanosensory inputs; top 200 two-hop bridge cells (from either input population) by minimum incoming/outgoing contact strength. Ties by body ID. No game outcomes used.
assumptions: Engineered channel injection (rank tier, not named cell subtype identity). Simplified signed, normalized, leaky tanh rate units. Acetylcholine +1, GABA/glutamate -1; unknown and modulatory transmitters 0. Not a physiological or whole-brain model.
